mountains.placement_code: if (z < -38 && h > 18) return 'snow_mountain'; if (z < -38 && h > 10) return 'snow_rock';

forest.placement_code: if (z < -20 && z > -38 && x < 5 && x > -28 && h > 7) return 'conifer_forest';

highlands.placement_code: if (x > 18 && x < 40 && z > -35 && z < -15 && h > 8) return 'highlands';

jungle.placement_code: if (x > -22 && x < 10 && z > -20 && z < 5 && h < 10 && vdist > 15) return 'jungle';

grove.placement_code: if (x > 20 && x < 38 && z > -18 && z < -2 && h < 7 && vdist > 15) return 'flowering_grove';

grassland.placement_code: if (x > 0 && x < 28 && z > 5 && z < 25 && h < 7 && vdist > 15) return 'grassland';

desert.placement_code: if (x > 25 && z > 15 && z < 42 && x < 52 && vdist > 15 && h < 7) return 'desert'; if (x > 32 && z > 22 && h > 10 && vdist > 15) return 'desert_mountain';

volcano.placement_code: if (vdist < 14 && h > 8) return 'volcano'; if (vdist < 16 && h > 5) return 'volcanic_ground';
volcano.elevation_code: const vcone = Math.max(0, 36 - vdist * 2.8); h += vcone * (vdist < 13 ? 1.0 : Math.max(0, 1.0 - (vdist - 13) / 8));
